meta.name: convex-create-component
meta.description: Builds reusable Convex components with isolated tables and app-facing APIs. Use for new components, reusable backend modules, integrations, or component boundary work.

copy.tagline: 构建可复用的 Convex 后端组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Convex 开发后端，需要封装可复用的数据模块和 API。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing with Convex and need to encapsulate reusable data modules and APIs.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要构建可复用的Convex组件时，Claude会先确认你的目标和组件形态（本地、打包或混合），然后生成组件目录、配置、数据表和函数代码，再把组件接入应用，并创建应用层的包装函数供客户端调用。
howto.when: 当你要求新建Convex组件、抽取可复用后端模块或构建第三方集成，或涉及组件边界时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个通知组件，支持发送和查询未读消息。
say.note: Claude会确认需求并生成组件骨架。

say.text: 把用户认证逻辑抽成一个可复用的Convex组件。
say.note: Claude会规划边界并提取组件。

say.text: 做一个第三方集成组件，让它自己管理数据表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can build reusable Convex components: it asks about the goal, chooses a shape (local/packaged/hybrid), creates component files (config, schema, functions), wires it into the app, and adds app-side wrappers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create a new Convex component, extract reusable backend logic, or build third-party integrations.

say_en.text: Create a notification component that can send and query unread messages.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the shape and generate the skeleton.

say_en.text: Extract the user authentication logic into a reusable Convex component.
say_en.note: Claude will plan boundaries and extract the component.

say_en.text: Build a third-party integration component that manages its own tables.
say_en.note: Claude will create isolated tables and a public API.
